description: Quiet dependency-update policy for active fearandesire repositories.

Pull requests open only for major updates and security fixes. Security fixes open as PRs straight away: Renovate cannot filter by severity, and a critical fix must never sit waiting for a dashboard tick.
GitHub branch protection remains the final merge gate.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch, digest, pin and lockfile updates stay off. Security fixes still open (after approval) because vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this rule.
Major updates open as PRs and are never merged automatically
Package replacements wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
